notes: GA is the existing production group ID 2; its original real members were preserved during every update. The 3/2/1/0 GA membership matrix refers only to additional TEST members, not removal of real staff.
All real GA settings were restored in finally and confirmed again by the UI run: original manager, member list, active flag, email, name and description.
Normal group manager and members were restored to the retained TEST baseline after both API and UI runs. Ticket 14482 remains processing for review.

The first two direct API setup creates failed with HTTP 500 because the original TEST group name exceeded the existing ticket-code length limit by one character. The frontend already guards this condition; the fixture was renamed to TEST_HND_IXWMUE, reconciled before retry and successful creates were read back.
The API and UI assert department-specific permissions from list_button and current candidate lists. GA hidden business rules beyond these exercised cases are not inferred.
Group edits now refresh the current account profile and invalidate ticket/create lookup caches so stale assignment controls are not retained in the same client.
User creation response was sanitized: password hashes and credentials are excluded from this report. No unrelated ticket or existing employee account was edited.
